280599462.description:
Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

280392175.description:
You are purchasing a "Agate Geode Slice on Black Metal Display Stand" in "Used" condition.
Striking agate geode on a metal stand, perfect as a statement décor piece for a shelf, desk, or entryway table. The polished face reveals shimmering crystals framed by rich, dark bands, while the sleek black stand gives it a modern gallery-style presentation. This single agate geode slice is mounted securely on a square metal base, making it easy to display as a natural focal point in your home or office. The unique crystal interior and organic shape ensure that this piece is truly one-of-a-kind and ideal for collectors, crystal lovers, or anyone wanting to add a touch of earthy elegance to their space. Keywords: agate geode, crystal decor, stone on stand, natural stone sculpture, geode slice, mineral display, home decor, office decor, tabletop sculpture
Condition Notes:
Agate geode slice securely mounted on a black metal stand. Geode face is polished with visible crystal formation and some natural inclusions and minor surface marks. Back side has a dark polished surface with scattered lighter mineral specks and some small chips or rough natural areas. Metal base shows scuffs, scratches, and some wear at the edges and on the underside. Rubber feet on the bottom of the base show light wear.
